cardOverview.overviewText: An ultra-exclusive invite-only card for HNWIs, providing unparalleled concierge services, luxury travel privileges, private banking perks, and personalized experiences.
cardOverview.bestSuited: Experience, Travel Booking, Hotel Transfer, Pay by Points

benefitRows.name: Accor Plus
benefitRows.howToAvail: To avail your Accor Plus membership, check your email for the activation link and membership number. Visit the Accor Plus activation page, enter your membership number and registered email, and follow the prompts to activate. Download the Accor ALL app and log in to access your digital membership card and benefits.

benefitRows.name: Axis Dining Delight
benefitRows.howToAvail: To avail this benefit, log in to the Axis Dining Delight portal or app using your registered Axis Bank account. Browse through curated dining offers, select your favorite restaurants, and redeem your offer at checkout. Use your Axis Burgundy Private credit card to unlock premium dining privileges and discounts.
